cases.question: 工单总数是多少？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0

cases.question: 按状态统计工单数量
cases.goldSql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY status

cases.question: 按来源统计工单数量
cases.goldSql: SELECT source, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY source

cases.question: 按优先级统计工单数量
cases.goldSql: SELECT priority, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY priority

cases.question: 状态为 CLOSED 的工单有多少张？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'CLOSED'

cases.question: 通知里未读的通知有多少条？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM notification WHERE deleted = 0 AND read_status = 0

cases.question: 已发布的知识文章有多少篇？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM knowledge_article WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1

cases.question: 知识分类一共有多少个？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM knowledge_category WHERE deleted = 0

cases.question: 工单评论里内部备注有多少条？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket_comment WHERE deleted = 0 AND is_internal = 1

cases.question: 启用中的 SLA 策略有几条？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM sla_policy WHERE deleted = 0 AND enabled = 1

cases.question: 按工单 id 统计每张工单的流转次数
cases.goldSql: SELECT ticket_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket_flow WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY ticket_id ORDER BY ticket_id

cases.question: 按工单 id 统计每张工单的评论数，没有评论的工单也要列出并把评论数记为 0
cases.goldSql: SELECT t.id, COUNT(c.id) AS cnt FROM ticket t LEFT JOIN ticket_comment c ON c.ticket_id = t.id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE t.deleted = 0 GROUP BY t.id ORDER BY t.id

cases.question: 2026-08-19 当天创建了多少张工单？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND DATE(created_at) = '2026-08-19'

cases.question: 按创建日期统计工单数量
cases.goldSql: SELECT DATE(created_at) AS d, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY d

cases.question: 流转记录里，从 IN_PROGRESS 流转到 RESOLVED 的记录有几条？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket_flow WHERE deleted = 0 AND from_status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND to_status = 'RESOLVED'

cases.question: 按操作人 id 统计每个操作人产生了多少条流转记录
cases.goldSql: SELECT operator_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket_flow WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY operator_id

cases.question: 按违规类型统计 SLA 违规记录数量
cases.goldSql: SELECT violation_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM sla_violation WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY violation_type

cases.question: 没有 SLA 计时记录的工单有多少张？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket t LEFT JOIN sla_timer s ON s.ticket_id = t.id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND s.id IS NULL

cases.question: 按分类 id 和分类名称统计每个工单分类下的工单数量，没有工单的分类显示 0
cases.goldSql: SELECT c.id, c.name, COUNT(t.id) AS cnt FROM ticket_category c LEFT JOIN ticket t ON t.category_id = c.id AND t.deleted = 0 WHERE c.deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY c.id

cases.question: 浏览量最高的那篇知识文章的标题是什么？
cases.goldSql: SELECT title FROM knowledge_article WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY view_count DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: 已解决的工单从创建到解决平均用了多少秒？
cases.goldSql: SELECT AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, created_at, resolved_at)) AS avg_seconds FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL

cases.question: 已关闭的工单从创建到关闭平均用了多少秒？
cases.goldSql: SELECT AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, created_at, closed_at)) AS avg_seconds FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND closed_at IS NOT NULL

cases.question: AI 推荐分类与工单实际分类一致的工单占全部工单的比例是多少？用 0 到 1 之间的小数表示
cases.goldSql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN category_id = ai_category_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS ratio FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0

cases.question: 有 SLA 违规的工单有多少张？同一张工单只算一次
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ticket_id) AS cnt FROM sla_violation WHERE deleted = 0

cases.question: 状态为已升级的 SLA 违规记录有几条？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM sla_violation WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1

cases.question: 按知识分类 id 和名称统计每个分类下已发布的文章数量，没有文章的分类显示 0
cases.goldSql: SELECT c.id, c.name, COUNT(a.id) AS cnt FROM knowledge_category c LEFT JOIN knowledge_article a ON a.category_id = c.id AND a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 1 WHERE c.deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY c.id

cases.question: 按通知类型统计未读通知的数量
cases.goldSql: SELECT type, SUM(read_status = 0) AS unread FROM notification WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY type

cases.question: 按工单 id，统计每张有 SLA 计时的工单，其解决截止时间比工单创建时间晚多少分钟
cases.goldSql: SELECT s.ticket_id, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, s.ticket_created_at, s.resolve_deadline) AS mins FROM sla_timer s WHERE s.deleted = 0 ORDER BY s.ticket_id

cases.question: 列出每条 SLA 违规记录对应的工单编号和违规类型
cases.goldSql: SELECT t.ticket_no, v.violation_type FROM sla_violation v JOIN ticket t ON t.id = v.ticket_id WHERE v.deleted = 0

cases.question: 按工单 id，统计每张工单的流转次数和评论数，没有记录的显示 0
cases.goldSql: SELECT t.id, COALESCE(f.cnt, 0) AS flows, COALESCE(c.cnt, 0) AS comments FROM ticket t LEFT JOIN (SELECT ticket_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket_flow WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY ticket_id) f ON f.ticket_id = t.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT ticket_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket_comment WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY ticket_id) c ON c.ticket_id = t.id WHERE t.deleted = 0 ORDER BY t.id
